text:
marco: Heads-up 10: planning a cross-APAC + ANZ launch webinar for May 3. Need an asset bundle and lead-routing rules. Minimal ask: hero + 3 social-sized tiles + 2 GIF promos + 16:9 deck template + localized landing micro-form. Delivery target: Tue COB (48h).

ivy: Can you confirm locales? and whether CN needs simplified Chinese copy or just imagery?

marco: Locales: EN (global), ZH-CN (simplified Chinese), EN-AU (AU/NZ messaging tweaks). CN needs translated copy + alternate imagery (business-focused photography).

sasha: I'll own creative. Quick spec proposal below: 
- Hero: 1920x1080 (desktop), 1200x628 (social preview)
- Social tiles: 1080x1080 (square), 1080x1350 (tall), 1200x630 (link)
- GIF promos: 800x450 (6s loop, autoplay-safe), 600x600 (square)
- Slide deck: 16:9 master + 4:5 repurpose layout
- Thumbnails: 320x180 for replay library
- Source files: Figma + exported PNGs + WebM for motion

designbot: Export/QA checklist:
```
- Colors: provide default + high-contrast variant (WCAG AA for body, AAA for CTAs if possible)
- Fonts: Inter (fallback system sans). Include font-license note.
- GIFs: 6s loop, max 3MB, 24fps. Provide WebM for high quality.
- Accessibility: alt text lines for each asset, captions for GIFs.
- Naming: LAUNCH_MAY03_<locale>_<asset>_v1.png
```
\nmarco: Messaging: primary CTA "Save your seat". CN CTA: "免费报名". Add UTM: utm_source=social, utm_medium=post, utm_campaign=launch-may-asia. Please bake into demo links.

salesops: Lead routing mapping (for registration webhooks):
- country = CN -> assign queue_cn_enterprise
- country in [AU,NZ] -> assign queue_apac_anz
- country in [SG,HK,MY] -> assign queue_apac_regional
- country in [GB,DE,FR] -> queue_emea_general
- country in [US,CA] -> queue_namer_general
Add field: lead.is_launch_may = true. Also capture opt_in_marketing boolean and timezone_choice string.

marco: Need micro-form fields for CN landing page: name, email, company, job_title, timezone (picker), consent checkbox (text below). Also include PDPA/GDPR note for APAC locales.

legal: Flags: no comparative claims or unverified savings. If we reference latency/cost numbers, add slide footnote with source and date. For CN translations, legal needs to approve privacy line; ping me with final copy.

ivy: I'll run ZH-CN copy and the privacy line through legal. ETA 3 hours.

sasha: Design Q: do we create a unique visual lock for CN hero (vertical badge, alternate logo color) or keep global look? Creating unique lock adds 4-6h.

marco: Keep global layout for speed, swap imagery and headline. If we have bandwidth, add CN badge as optional.

sasha: Understood. I'll push first-pass screens (PNG) to the Figma project in ~6h.

designbot: Figma link uploaded: https://figma.com/file/xyz789/launch-may-asia (dev). Files exported and initial names: `LAUNCH_MAY03_EN_HERO.png`, `LAUNCH_MAY03_ZH_GIF_800x450.webm`, etc.

ivy: Social copy plan: 3 headline variants per locale + 2 CTA pairings for A/B. I'll post copy drafts in thread before EOD.

salesops: For CRM: include utm_campaign mapping. If utm_campaign=="launch-may-asia" set attribution.campaign = "launch_may_2026_asia". Also set lead.region_hint when locale detected.

legal: Reminder: include cookie/consent checkbox wording in EN & ZH for landing page; provide exact phrasing to legal for approval.

sasha: Upload checklist for final delivery: layered Figma source, PNGs (1x + 2x), WebM, GIF (if still needed), slide deck source (.pptx/.key) and README with file sizes and alt text.

marco: Tag final assets under marketing-assets/launches/may-03-2026 and add label `launch/may/asia`. Also attach a short delivery note with QA checks.

ivy: Noted. I'll attach translations and consent copy once legal signs off.

marco: Great. Next steps: sasha -> mock PNGs; ivy -> localized copy; legal -> privacy/consent check; salesops -> webhook mapping + micro-form schema. Catchup in 8h for handoff. :rocket:
